pr_title: Add support for function pointers in ilverify
pr_body:
Cherry-picked the commit from #43627 and added support in importer.
Added tests which required both fixes to pass.

Fix #43502
pr_comments:
@jkotas, thanks for the great review! :)

One thing I noticed is that the test runner and ILVerify/Program.cs have some differences which makes ILVerify report more errors than the test runner. Do you know offhand what is the major difference and if it is intentional?

e.g. I executed:

````sh
# run ilverify(1) on all ilverify test assemblies
./dotnet.sh artifacts/bin/ILVerify/x64/Release/ILVerify.dll -c -t \
  -r artifacts/bin/coreclr/OSX.x64.Release/*.dll \
  -r artifacts/bin/System.Runtime/net6.0-Release/*.dll \
  -s System.Runtime artifacts/tests/coreclr/OSX.x64.Release/ilverify/Tests/*.dll
````
and it reported 188 errors vs. the test runs:
```sh
# run ilverify tests via ilverify test runner
bash artifacts/tests/coreclr/OSX.x64.Release/ilverify/ILVerification.Tests.sh \
  -coreroot=$(pwd)/artifacts/tests/coreclr/OSX.x64.Release/Tests/Core_Root
```
that report 0 errors (all tests are passing).

I made a simplified IL test case for #55033, and it was passing with test runner but failing with `artifacts/bin/ILVerify/x64/Release/ILVerify.dll ` as follows:
```sh
[IL]: Error [InitOnly]: [/Users/adeel/projects/runtime/artifacts/tests/coreclr/OSX.x64.Release/ilverify/Tests/InitOnlyTest.dll : InitOnlyTest.D::GetHashCode()][offset 0x00000006] Cannot change initonly field outside its .ctor.
1 Error(s) Verifying /Users/adeel/projects/runtime/artifacts/tests/coreclr/OSX.x64.Release/ilverify/Tests/InitOnlyTest.dll
```
(it is bit unfortunate that there are no PDB symbols which in case of repo tests can be conveniently available)

The test runner is only verifying methods that match the `*_Valid_*` and `*_Invalid_*` naming pattern: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/tree/main/src/coreclr/tools/ILVerify#defining-tests

ilverify tool is verifying all methods in the given assembly, unless you use a filter argument to restrict what should be verified.
True, I forgot about the invalid cases. I will check how to make the test for 55033 so it fails with InitOnly error without the virtual method call (which apparently does not fail).

issue_context.title: ILVerify crashes when sees FunctionPointerType
issue_context.body:
Running ilverify tool on SPC crashes with following exception

```
Verifying [System.Private.CoreLib]System.Globalization.CalendarData.EnumCalendarInfo
Error: System.InvalidCastException: Unable to cast object of type 'Internal.TypeSystem.FunctionPointerType' to type 'Internal.TypeSystem.Ecma.EcmaType'.
   at ILVerify.AccessVerificationHelpers.CanAccess(TypeDesc currentClass, TypeDesc targetClass)
   at ILVerify.AccessVerificationHelpers.CanAccessMethodSignature(TypeDesc currentType, MethodDesc targetMethod)
   at Internal.IL.ILImporter.ImportCall(ILOpcode opcode, Int32 token)
   at Internal.IL.ILImporter.ImportBasicBlock(BasicBlock basicBlock)
   at Internal.IL.ILImporter.ImportBasicBlocks()
   at ILVerify.Verifier.VerifyMethod(EcmaModule module, MethodIL methodIL, MethodDefinitionHandle methodHandle)
   at ILVerify.Verifier.VerifyMethods(EcmaModule module, IEnumerable`1 methodHandles)+MoveNext()
   at ILVerify.Verifier.Verify(PEReader peReader, MethodDefinitionHandle methodHandle)+MoveNext()
   at ILVerify.Program.VerifyMethods(PEReader peReader, EcmaModule module, String path, Int32& numErrors, Int32& verifiedMethodCounter, Int32& methodCounter)
   at ILVerify.Program.VerifyAssembly(PEReader peReader, EcmaModule module, String path)
   at ILVerify.Program.Run()
   at ILVerify.Program.Run(Options options)
```

review_comments: It would be nice to also add a test that exercises `CanAccessSignature` returning false for function pointer here.
The negative test in IL is `Dispatcher_Invalid_MethodAccess` which covers the access issue. Do you mean other invalid cases we should add?

The function pointer signature in `Dispatcher_Invalid_MethodAccess` is `void *(int32)`. This signature won't fail in function pointer signature access check. `currentClass.CanAccessSignature(((FunctionPointerType)targetClass).Signature)` will return true.

`Dispatcher_Invalid_MethodAccess` fails in owning type access check. It means that it is not actually testing the function pointer access checks.

I meant to add a test that actually fails the function pointer signature access check, ie where this `CanAccessSignature` call returns false.
